paragraphs: Rabbi Eliezer ben Shemayah of Kefar Otnai asked Yochanan ben Zakkai, who told him, “Shemayah, go sprinkle your water,” Tosefta Parah 10:2 in Machon Mamre [chapter 9 in Rash MiShantz’s citation and in the printed Heilprin].
